report.verdict: A strong senior engineer resume, but Cobalt Pay's manager role asks for people management it doesn't show.
write_up: Cobalt Pay is hiring a people manager, while your resume points to senior engineering work. I read it for Senior Software Engineer: your path from Cascade Health Systems to Tidewater Commerce shows backend, platform and payments work with measurable results.

Your engineering resume is strong! The GitHub Actions line pairs the templates you wrote with a build-time improvement, so a recruiter can see both the work and what changed. At Tidewater, though, office activities sit between major platform and payments projects.

For Cobalt Pay, bring the payment failover work forward and make room by trimming less relevant activities. If you've managed engineers, hired or owned a roadmap, add those responsibilities; mentoring interns alone doesn't establish the management experience this posting requests.
